name: s5_core_plus_cat
note: The five LightGBM configs that scored 0.54151 as submission 2, plus cat_base, equally weighted, 2 seeds each. Chosen from leaderboard evidence rather than local AP: submission 3 showed that adding 8 near-clone LightGBM recency/window variants COST 0.0025 on the board while gaining 0.0023 locally, so more members is not free - but cat_base is a different algorithm with different failure modes and is the best single model in the project. Minimal principled step from the best known clean configuration. Clean line: USE_SIGNUP_INCONSISTENCY=False.
